about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a software developer who cares about the space between "it works" and "it feels right".
about.p2: I enjoy turning messy problems into simple, maintainable interfaces and services. I write clean code, favour the platform over heavy dependencies, and treat performance and accessibility as features, not afterthoughts.
about.p3: I'm currently looking for a role where I can learn from a strong team and ship things people actually use.
